TAIMUR KHAN PORTFOLIO — PHOTO GUIDE

WhatsApp: +92 308 9342404 (already connected ✅)

HOW TO ADD YOUR PHOTO:
----------------------
1. Remove background from your picture:
   - Go to https://www.remove.bg and upload your photo
   - Download the transparent PNG

2. Rename the file to ONE of these:
   - taimur.png  (best — transparent background)
   - taimur.jpg
   - taimur.jpeg
   - taimur.webp

3. Put it in this folder: public/
   Example: public/taimur.png

4. Rebuild / redeploy — your photo appears automatically
   in Hero + Contact Card with glow ring.

TIP: Use a clear front-face photo in good light.

NOTES:
------
- Certificates are already built-in (ICIP + 128 IQ).
  No images needed for them.
- "Verify Online" button has been removed as requested.
- Website is fully responsive (mobile / tablet / desktop).
